entry.title: Block-wide Signature Aggregation via SNARKs
entry.summary:
The recent discussion on Bitcoin Core development highlights a strategic recommendation to integrate both the prover and verifier components rather than limiting the update to the verifier alone. This approach is advocated based on the expectation that Bitcoin Core, being the primary platform, attracts more thorough review and scrutiny compared to lesser-known scripts like `miner_algo_version1.0_final_(copy)_newversion.sh`. The integration of the prover into Bitcoin Core is suggested as a means to leverage the broader community engagement and expertise concentrated around Bitcoin Core, which likely results in more robust and reliable software enhancements.
Incorporating the prover into Bitcoin Core not only streamlines the development process by centralizing updates in one major repository but also potentially increases the security and integrity of the system. This centralized model ensures that any improvements or changes undergo rigorous evaluation by a large pool of developers and reviewers who are already familiar with the core system, thus enhancing overall system reliability and performance.
